title: Sparkly paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='paperTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#dfeaff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='paperBottom' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfe0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a9c4f5'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='fold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#eaf2ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- trail -->
  <path d='M6 70 Q22 64 34 56' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M8 80 Q24 74 38 66' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- main body (top wing) -->
  <path d='M45 22 L88 40 L52 58 Z' fill='url(#paperTop)'/>

  <!-- lower wing -->
  <path d='M45 22 L52 58 L30 74 Z' fill='url(#paperBottom)'/>

  <!-- folded edge highlight -->
  <path d='M45 22 L52 58 L50 44 Z' fill='url(#fold)'/>

  <!-- wing crease -->
  <path d='M52 58 L88 40' stroke='#a9c4f5' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g>
    <path d='M22 28 L24 34 L30 36 L24 38 L22 44 L20 38 L14 36 L20 34 Z' fill='#fff3a3'/>
    <path d='M74 18 L75.6 22.4 L80 24 L75.6 25.6 L74 30 L72.4 25.6 L68 24 L72.4 22.4 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <path d='M82 62 L83.4 65.6 L87 67 L83.4 68.4 L82 72 L80.6 68.4 L77 67 L80.6 65.6 Z' fill='#fff3a3'/>
    <path d='M34 84 L35.2 87 L38 88 L35.2 89 L34 92 L32.8 89 L30 88 L32.8 87 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  </g>
</svg>
